stem: The masses of a certain species of animal are known to be normally distributed with standard deviation $\sigma$ kg. A researcher obtains the masses of a random sample of $n$ animals of this species and uses these masses to find two confidence intervals ($\alpha$% and 90%) for the population mean. The width of the $\alpha$% confidence interval is $1.414 \times$ the width of the 90% confidence interval.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Find the probability that the 90% confidence interval contains the population mean given that the $\alpha$% confidence interval contains the population mean.
